title: Neon Snake component diagram
description: The Godot client runs the whole game in the browser; the page's boot script starts it, and the Worker only checks the sign-in and serves the files.

components.name: Neon Snake
components.responsibility: The game, its page and its Worker.

components.name: Godot client
components.responsibility: Rules, drawing, particles, HUD, input and synthesised sound, all in GDScript.

components.name: Boot script
components.responsibility: Starts the engine from the page, fills the loading bar, reports a browser that can't run it.

components.name: snake Worker
components.responsibility: The page for signed-in players only; the engine file joined from its parts; everything else a static asset.

relationships.description: new Engine(config).startGame() on the web export.
